rock_python: A giant Aegean rock python: a massive thick-bodied constrictor, olive and ochre scales with a bold dark brown blotched saddle pattern, pale cream belly scales, a broad flat head with heat pits, coiled in a loose S with the head raised and tongue out.
hydra_scaled: A hydra-scaled serpent, the veteran form: a huge serpent with armoured teal-green scales that shade to bronze on the belly, a crest of small bony spines down the spine, a pair of horn-like brow ridges, pale yellow eyes with slit pupils, body half coiled with the front third reared up.
marble_viper: A marble viper of the temple ruins: a lean serpent whose scales are chalk-white and grey like veined marble, with a dark zigzag dorsal stripe, triangular head, blood-red eyes, winding between the fallen column drums it hides among.
sea_serpent: A coastal sea serpent that hunts the shoreline: a sleek deep blue-black serpent with silver-cream underside, a low fin crest along the back, pale eyes, body in sinuous curves as if moving from water onto sand.
bronze_adder: A bronze adder: a mid-sized thick viper with scales like hammered bronze and copper, a dark diamond pattern, a short tail with a rattle-like knob, hooded neck flared slightly, head low and ready to strike.
shadow_asp: A shadow asp from the grove: a slender black serpent with faint iridescent purple sheen, a thin gold ring behind the head, small golden eyes, slipping out of long grass with only the front half visible and raised.
